ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels across the primary surface area, contrasted against 15% low-intensity (dark) pixels localized to the trailing edge perimeter and peduncle insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous mass across both lobes. Dark-intensity pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edges and terminal tips. A high-contrast dark region is localized at the inferior central junction (peduncle). Discrete circular dark spots are mapped to the distal portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 16% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 15 pixels. Irregular peak-to-valley spacing is more pronounced on the medial half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a moderately concave curve transitioning from the notch toward the distal tips; outer tips show a convex, tapering trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters on the left lobe distal section. High-intensity, irregular pixel rosettes (consistent with barnacle attachment points) are visible at the extreme tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense mapping of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions. Significant parallel diagonal rake marks are visible on the left lobe; multiple intersecting linear marks are distributed across the medial and distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the entire visible ventral surface. The right distal tip shows irregular, non-linear pixel clusters and jagged geometric deviation.
other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent, isolated dark circular spots on the distal-mid portion of the left lobe.
